Welcome to Graduate Studies in Computer Science and Engineering
Notre Dame’s graduate programs in Computer Science and Engineering lead to high-impact research careers in the academy, industry, and government.
Our graduate students engage in interdisciplinary research with faculty working across five broad areas:
Data Science and Artificial Intelligence
Computer Architecture and Systems
Software Engineering
Human-Computer Interaction and Visualization
Theory and Algorithms
Explore Research and Meet Faculty
in Computer Science and Engineering
As a student in our Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering, you’ll have opportunities to work within and across those areas, as well as in University research centers.
Research centers led by faculty in Computer Science and Engineering include the Notre Dame Technology Ethics Center, the Institute for Data Science and Society, the Institute for Global Development, the Center for Research Computing, the Institute for Global Health, the Institute for Precision Health, the Institute for Advanced Study.
Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering
Our primary graduate degree program, the Ph.D. in Computer Science and Engineering, welcomes applications from highly motivated students.
Learn more and apply to
the Ph.D. program
Master of Science in Computer Science and Engineering
The M.S. program provides advanced training in the latest computing concepts and technologies. M.S. students graduate with the flexibility to pursue careers in research and industry, or to go on to doctoral study.
